name: 断界寻绳 A3
scope: Offline fixed400 open-development images, left/right200, original 4096x3000 unmirrored. No hardware/reserved data/training/control.

baseline_F3.archive: D:/precise_arrangement/工程导航/05_实验版本档案/卷绳边界_全卷面基准_F3_20261028

original_interruption_evidence.interpretation: No confirmed n-1 rule match; F3 shape is geometric candidate/gating guidance. Continuous or broken image groove alone is not material identity.

development_history.finding: unrestricted local ribbon search followed old coils too early; some tails continued on flange/background; geometric false intersections and narrow free strand seed found
development_history.source_note: run_start keeps hashes; free source snapshot exists; complete core snapshots start at pilot002

development_history.finding: fixed original-channel selection, broad outer-edge remeasurement, outward free extension, coherent curve grouping, convex/gated beam, finite visible domain, terminal alternatives; much smoother but undercoverage/neighbor ambiguity remain

external edge-side association bug repair, review-mask rendering, bounded single-edge straight inference. Four reviewed selected centerlines did not change, no demonstrated coverage benefit from 18w in those four
inherited S cuts visible rope (ruler_left05); convex search-only envelope restores bright straight span, not validated dark same-rope bend

methods: cached automatic A1/A2 free seed, revalidated from original; no old chosen connection used
outside whole-rope double-edge profiles estimate pixel width and axis; strand tensor describes orientation only
original-image wide-groove continuity rechecked around F3 references; old F3 exclusion holes do not count as occlusion
multiple width-constrained bright/dark ribbons, convex image geometry, finite F3 tangency zones, original paired edges, rotated strand orientation, terminal competing paths
single side can support a bounded fixed straight hypothesis but never paired observed support; selected candidate and review mask separated
visibility hull is only bounded search envelope, not a new SAM segmentation or measured rope mask
limitations: Whole extent candidates are not validated whole-rope successes; even unique score winner can be a neighboring old coil.
142 cases lack a usable saved automatic free seed, 1 seed fails revalidation, 1 width ambiguous. Empty does not prove absence of active rope.
Many partial/free-only cases stop before still-visible rope; inherited visibility and raw contrast can limit coverage.
No exact physical contact point, material identity, t0/t1/t2 or mm diameter is established.
Executable uses saved open400 F3/A1/A2 predictions; it is not yet a standalone arbitrary-new-image pipeline.
Original G0 in runner uses old S; its unequal support domain is recorded, not claimed as fair curve gain. New equal-domain independent G0 comparison is separately recorded.

outputs.01_整根候选掩膜: 400 binary PNGs, 0 background/255 selected candidate including uncertain continuation; may be partial or empty
outputs.02_原图叠加: 400 original-size overlays; green image support, orange inferred or continuity needs review
outputs.03_实测支持掩膜: 400 binary PNGs for local measured appearance, not identity truth
outputs.04_接续待确认: 400 binary PNGs for weak/competing/unverified curved continuation; can overlap image support
outputs.records: 400 JSON with all candidates, raw evidence, status and dependency hashes

truth_claim: No accuracy claimed; qualitative inspections and structural reproducibility are separate.

equal_domain_geometry_comparison.observations: Same-domain G0 matches final geometry closely for ruler_left05/right05. rightdual315 and ruler_left01 have bend/termination differences (~70/58px endpoints), without verified dark-tail identity gain.
